Pathweft selective search integration

EverythingToolbar source: a4379f181ea8e9b4d3ff8b0e5178d8d39491830c
The search client adapted from EverythingToolbar.Platform/Search/EverythingIpcClient.cs
was removed in Pathweft 1.1.80 (SEARCH-09); searches go to the Pathweft index service.

S2 selected taskbar/search integration, same pinned EverythingToolbar revision:
EverythingToolbar/Services/TaskbarLayoutProbe.cs: UI Automation obstacle measurement.
EverythingToolbar/TaskbarWindow.xaml.cs: native child attachment and safe layout.
EverythingToolbar/Controls/ToolbarControl.xaml.cs and Controls/SearchBox.xaml.cs:
search entry, focus, Enter/Escape and keyboard movement behavior.
EverythingToolbar.Launcher/Launcher.cs: registered Explorer TaskbarCreated message.
EverythingToolbar.Launcher/TaskbarWindowHost.cs: explicit box/hotkey mode ownership.
Adapted into TaskbarSearchHost.cs, SearchWidgetWindow.cs and Search/TaskbarLayout.cs.
No donor updater, setup assistant, separate tray product, forced foreground hook,
timer-driven attach retries, settling deadline or animation polling is imported.
Pathweft's existing PaneView, settings owner and Ferry queue are reused.

S8 four inline search toggles reference Controls/SearchBox.xaml at the same pin:
Match case, Match whole word, Match path and Regex; whole-word is disabled while
Regex is active. Adapted into PaneView's existing unified address/search field.
Everything-style query modifiers are applied to the user expression so these
options cannot turn the separately composed folder boundary into a regex.
